criteria.keep_generated_issuer_refused: Retain the current fail-closed lack of callable source issuer for generated programs rather than replay Given inputs. Make unsupported scope explicit and keep runtime refusal; ordinary non-generated source remains usable. Avoids new retained input state or reconstruction and minimizes immediate compiler changes, but generated workflows needing checked native callable predicates remain unavailable until a later defining implementation; it cannot claim original PromptLab acceptance or bypass the runtime gate.
criteria.retain_private_checked_inputs: Store an optional private clone of the original validated GivenContractTables on CheckedProgram when check_program_with_given constructs it. Expose only a compiler-internal borrowed replay input/helper. FreshSourceContext validates its existing cohort, then uses exactly those original inputs in both check_program_with_given and try_resolve_program_with_given, preserving full fresh analysis/IR/census comparisons and all tamper refusals. Ordinary no-Given checks retain None. Adds retained compiler-private input memory and plumbing; introduces no public serialized authority and avoids reconstructing richer inputs from derived mutable outputs.
criteria.reconstruct_and_verify: Reconstruct the complete original GivenContractTables from current public IR/type generated fields plus original source/census and verified saved associations, with explicit checks for every trait/keyword, source order, target, attachment, field type/default/constraints and omission. Feed the reconstructed tables into existing fresh check/resolve and keep all full comparisons. Avoids storing a private copy on CheckedProgram, but requires a complete reversible reconstruction and provenance checks across publicly editable derived structures; partial reconstruction cannot satisfy this option.
